title: False positive — T4 live, multi-writer LWW stated honestly with the trade-off accepted
expected_feedback: No violations. Trigger T4 is genuinely live — several writers touch one record — so this is precisely the case where an over-strict reviewer reaches for 'multi-writer without ETag is a FAIL'. That would be a false positive. §8.1 asks which of three things is true: a policy is stated, and its premise holds. Presence really is advisory, it really is refreshed on a 5-second heartbeat, and durable content really is handled by a separate CRDT endpoint, so a lost update costs nothing and self-heals. Contrast API-021, where the premise was falsified by a second writer the spec did not acknowledge. The difference is not multi-writer versus single-writer — both are multi-writer — it is whether the stated justification survives contact with the design. Record the trade-off in the report; do not score it. A reviewer may note that the 5s heartbeat is load-bearing and should be documented as a constraint, which is a [D] suggestion, not a defect.
must_not_flag: multi-writer last-write-wins reported as a defect when the stated premise holds
a demand for ETag/If-Match on an advisory, self-healing resource under T4
